$comment: Every alert of docs/monitoring-plan.md §4.4 and where it lives. status: rule = a Prometheus rule in ops/alerts/*.rules.yaml with promtool tests; partial = a rule exists for the part whose signal exists, the rest needs the metric in 'missing'; metric_missing = no rule yet because the signal does not exist — 'missing' names the exact metric the owner must export; outside = not a Prometheus alert (portal notice, job, external check). Checked by ops/internal/alertlint (go test ./internal/alertlint).

FreshnessSLOAtRisk.missing: scf_freshness_canary_visible_total{source,path_kind,within} — canaries timed from send to visibility through the public read API (within = 5m | 60m | late), every 5 min

IngestCapacityDegraded.missing: provider label on node verdicts, e.g. scf_health_controller_node_up{node,provider} — for the 'all nodes of one provider unhealthy' part

DNSRecordDrift.missing: scf_dns_static_drift{provider,zone} from the DNS-as-code check of the static records (C-27); the health-controller part is a rule

DNSRecordForeign.missing: scf_dns_foreign_records{provider,zone} — published records pointing outside the IP inventory

SupportResponseDue.where: support-ticket automation (labels at business day 4 and 8)

DuplicateForwardsHigh.note: counts deliveries after an attempt whose outcome is unknown (written request + transport error or 500/502/504); a crash between Umami storing and the spool ack is not counted (C-124)

DurabilityDiscrepancy.missing: scf_durability_discrepancy{node} (records fsync'd − acknowledged − expired − queued, per node and day) and scf_durability_report_timestamp_seconds{node}

CanaryCountMismatch.missing: scf_durability_canary_shortfall{source} — canary events sent minus counted in Umami for the last drained hour

StreamResetsHigh.where: portal notice to the tenant (control plane, from api data-quality counters); no per-tenant Prometheus label by design

RejectedWebSpikePlatform.note: scf_gateway_reasons_total carries suspect and rejected reason codes together (no verdict label)

OTLPRejectedSpike.note: reason time_bounds is decided by the metrics writer (too_old/future), not by the gateway

CardinalityOverflow.where: portal notice to the tenant (control plane)

CardinalityOverflowPlatform.missing: scf_writer_route_overflow_tenants (tenants with a route sent to {overflow} today) — for the '> 5 tenants' part; the memory-limiter part is a rule

RedactedValuesSeen.where: portal notice to the tenant (control plane)

CollectorQueueHigh.note: oldest-batch age is not exported by the v0.165 queue; the 72-hour cap is enforced by the writer (C-112)

SiteRateLimited.missing: the tenant-facing portal notice (portal function, not a Prometheus alert); the maintainer warning (> 10 sites in an hour) is the rule

SuspectSurgeOnSite.where: portal notice to the tenant and operator_admins (trust score, control plane)

RLSCoverageDrift.missing: scf_rls_coverage_violations (rows of the scheduled RLS-coverage query)

AdapterForbidden.note: from the engine proxy's answers to reader/provisioner calls

CrossTenantFanout.missing: scf_cross_tenant_contexts{actor_class} (tenant contexts touched per 10 min outside allow-listed jobs)

SCFOperatorBulkRead.note: scf_cp_operator_reads_total{operator_ref} counts GET operations of the operator console per pseudonymous operator; floor of 50 reads/hour (control-plane.rules.yaml)

SCFOperatorPrivilegedAction.where: portal notice to all operator_admins (control plane, audit rows)

SCFOperatorAuthAnomaly.note: scf_cp_auth_events_total does not separate SCF operators from tenant members who use a passkey

OpKeyAnomaly.missing: scf_cp_op_key_events_total{kind="new_network_class"} — a key used from a network class it was not seen from before (the key's network classes are not tracked yet); bad_checksum, key_in_url and rate_limited are a rule

RevokedTokenStillAccepted.missing: scf_gateway_ing_token_accepted_after_revocation_total — an ing token accepted > 60 s after revocation by a node with a fresh snapshot; the op-key part (scf_cp_op_key_accepted_after_revocation_total) is a rule

UnexpectedListener.missing: scf_listener_scan_diff{scanner} (daily external and internal scan vs hardening.md §2)

NodeVerdictDivergence.note: verified share per node; per-tenant traffic share needs per-node tenant counters (not exported, by design)

TrackerHashDrift.missing: scf_tracker_hash_drift{target,version} (hourly fetch per node vs the signed manifest; 410 check for withdrawn versions)

NpmUnexpectedVersion.where: external check (npm version list vs release list)

DependencyAdvisoryUrgent.missing: scf_advisories_open{severity} (advisories matching a pinned dependency, runtime or image)

UmamiUpstreamSecuritySignal.missing: scf_advisories_open_by_kind{kind="umami",severity} (Umami upstream advisories against the pinned engine)

DeployVerifyFailed.where: deploy playbook (cosign verify), reported by the playbook

MonitoringNodeAccess.missing: scf_host_access_events_total{kind} (login, sudo, new_listener, inbound_flow) from auditd/journald on mon-c

VerifierEgressDenied.note: exported by the jobs service, which runs the domain verifier (C-125)

EdgeCPUHigh.note: needs the scrape label role="edge" on node_exporter targets (ops/prometheus)

BackupCheckFailing.missing: rule on scf_backup_check_success (pgbackrest check, hourly) built; still missing: scf_backup_verify_ok{repo} (pgbackrest verify output parsed for missing/WARN lines), scf_backup_repo_versioning_ok{repo}, scf_backup_repo_lifecycle_ok{repo}, scf_backup_credential_cannot_delete_versions{repo}

DeadMansSwitchMissed.where: scheduled GitHub workflow .github/workflows/deadman.yml (every 5 min) running ops/deadman/check.sh against the status host's heartbeat.json
